App details

Electrical Toolkit

Work out common electrical and electronic values from the measurements you enter.

In the worksPlannedAndroid

What it’s for

An offline helper for electronics projects and practical calculations. Enter voltage, current, resistance and component values to work out power, choose LED resistors, combine components or estimate voltage drop in a wire. You can also read resistor colour bands and printed codes.

Main features

  • Ohm’s law, power and component calculations.
  • Read resistor colour bands and printed codes.
  • Calculate resistor networks and LED resistors.
  • Wire resistance and voltage drop from entered data.

This app is planned. The description presents documented plans, not an app available to download. The final design and app still need approval and testing; there is no announced release date.

How to use

Choose a calculator and enter the values you know, with their units. For example, enter voltage and resistance to find current and power, or supply voltage and LED data to estimate a series resistor. Combine series or parallel components, read resistor colour bands or printed codes, and calculate wire resistance and voltage drop from your own parameters.

Important limits

Results describe the entered model and assumptions, not a tested circuit. The app does not design mains installations, certify electrical safety or simulate a full circuit. RF-specific work belongs to Ham Tools.

Offline use, permissions and purchases

The planned core functions run on the device without a JN86 account. Advertising, purchases, optional downloads and external links may need an internet connection. Offline core operation does not rule out separate service data flows.

Android 7.0 or newer is the common planned baseline. Individual sensor and platform features still depend on the device.

Permissions

Core calculations require no camera, microphone, contacts or location. Colour bands and component codes are entered manually.

Local data

Calculator inputs are processed locally and not sent to JN86. Display settings may persist; saved component libraries and calculation history are not planned.

Advertising and purchases

The plan keeps every core feature free, with banner advertising and an optional one-time Google Play purchase to remove ads. There is no subscription. Actual local prices will come from Play; advertising providers, consent choices and SDK data handling must be specified before launch.

First version and later ideas

The functions above belong to the documented plan for the first version. Features mentioned below as excluded or later ideas are not promised as current capabilities.

Ohm’s law, component networks and wire calculations are included. Circuit simulation, PCB design, saved components and mains-installation design are excluded.

Availability

This app is being created. The features described here are planned; it is not yet available to download.
